notes: Evaluates /cadence-mint atomic ID allocation guarantees: delegates strictly to mint-id.sh, flock serialization over git-common-dir shared across worktrees, zero gap backfill, ADR 4-digit vs PI 3-digit zero-padding, --seed single-init refusal, and strict no-directory-scan-fallback fail-loud contract.

evals.name: monotonic-flock-reservation-no-scan-fallback
evals.prompt: Reserve the next PI identifier when flock is unavailable in PATH.
evals.expected_output: Delegates to .agents/skills/cadence-mint/mint-id.sh --reserve PI, fails loud on missing flock emitting UNSOUND_CONDITION idalloc.reserve.lock_unavailable without printing an ID, and refuses to fall back to scanning specs/, archive/, or docs/ADR/.
assertions: Fails loud with non-zero exit when flock or ledger lock is unavailable
Never falls back to scanning specs/, archive/, or docs/ADR/ directories

evals.name: width-formatting-and-seed-guard
evals.prompt: Peek ADR vs PI formats and run --seed ADR 5 when ADR already has ledger rows.
evals.expected_output: Formats ADR with 4-digit zero-padding (ADR-0001) and PI/other prefixes with 3 digits (PI-001), shares ledger across linked worktrees via git-common-dir, never reuses gaps, and refuses --seed when prefix already has ledger entries.
assertions: Zero-pads ADR / ADR_CADENCE to 4 digits and other prefixes to 3 digits
Refuses --seed on an already-seeded prefix cleanly
